scope: Simulated deterministic planner scenarios using the unchanged fictional demo inventory. No human study, retail data or YouCam calls.

definitions.validCompleteAlternatives: Distinct complete event-to-item assignments satisfying all constraints, excluding the returned assignment. These are not necessarily equal-cost or equally optimal.
definitions.validMaximumCoverageAlternatives: Distinct assignments covering the same maximum number of events, excluding the returned assignment. These may cost more or use more borrowed pieces.
definitions.eventLocalCandidateCounts: Per-event outfit combinations before global spending and unique-loan constraints; not a count of feasible multi-event plans.
definitions.runtime: Synchronous makePlan only, five warmups followed by 25 local runs. Small fixture results are not scalability benchmarks.
